title: Complete Dense ZZ Resource FFI
objective: Complete generated dense integer matrix resources with exact transforms, kernels, polynomial invariants, ring conversion, structural operations, and lifecycle and performance evidence

oracles: current packed dense ZZ matrix implementation

handoff.summary: Added generated FmpzMatrix HNF/SNF transforms, exact-shaped right kernel, characteristic and minimal polynomial resources, direct Fmpz/Fmpq matrix conversions, contiguous submatrices, transactional block writes, stack, augment, and nonzero count. Extended lifecycle, external-memory, malformed-input, differential, edge-shape, transform-identity, and performance coverage. The representative 48x64 exact right kernel measures about 0.52 ms through the owned resource versus 1.67 ms through the packed boundary.
risks: These owned FLINT matrix resources remain Node-only declarations with wasm=False; WASM resource lowering is a separate architecture lane.

Arbitrary indexed row or column selection is not declared because the current declaration compiler rejects mixing a resource with an aggregate UInt64Buffer adapter; contiguous slicing and typed traversal remain available without an operation-specific host adapter.

pnpm test:portable is not clean on base 4db221d after rebuilding the self-hosted compiler: unrelated compiled-module-isolation/bootstrap assertions fail in files outside this lane. Focused FFI, sanitizer, architecture, and strict-baselib gates pass.
next_steps: Integrate these generated operations into the public dense ZZ Matrix representation without touching packed limb capacities.
Add the typed-Python resource structural kernels for construction, random fill, traversal, and public result assembly.
Decide whether arbitrary indexed selection merits a focused resource-plus-aggregate declaration compiler feature or should remain typed traversal.
